ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Ley 10/2010, de 28 de abril, de prevención del blanqueo de capitales y de la financiación del terrorismo (as amended; arts. 4.1, 14 and 34 governing UBO definition, PEPs and enhanced due diligence); Real Decreto 304/2014, de 5 de mayo (Reglamento de la Ley 10/2010, arts. 7-9); Ley 6/2023, de 17 de marzo, de los Mercados de Valores y de los Servicios de Inversión and implementing rules establishing the Registro Central de Titularidades Reales; Real Decreto 1784/1996, de 19 de julio (Reglamento del Registro Mercantil) on the internal UBO register; Ley 12/2003, de 21 de mayo, de bloqueo de la financiación del terrorismo; Directive (EU) 2015/849 and Directive (EU) 2018/843 (transposed); Regulation (EU) 2015/847 on information accompanying transfers of funds; SEPBLAC supervisory guidance and Banco de España good-practice circulars.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of passport or national identity card of each director and ultimate beneficial owner (UBO)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Consular or civil registry authority of the country of origin (Ministry of Foreign Affairs, civil registry, or qualified notary public)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille under the 1961 Convention for Contracting States; otherwise full Consular Legalization through the Spanish Consulate having jurisdiction over the country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of good standing or official registry extract of any foreign corporate shareholder (where a shareholder is an entity)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent commercial or company registry of the shareholder's domicile
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization, followed by sworn Spanish translation (traducción jurada) by a MAEC-accredited translator

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Escritura de Constitución (public notarial deed of incorporation of the SL, including by-laws, capital subscription, UBO declarations and director appointments)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Spanish Notary (Notario) with jurisdiction over the registered office
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarial protocol transcript; no apostille required domestically. Deed must be presented for inscription at the Registro Mercantil within 30 days of execution as prudent practice.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificación Negativa de Denominación Social (official name-clearance certificate issued by the central commercial registry)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Registro Mercantil Central, Colegio de Registradores de España
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Official digital verification code printed on the certificate; no apostille required for domestic corporate law purposes

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter and source-of-funds declaration supporting the minimum paid-in capital (EUR 3,000) and transparency of capital origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Spanish or other EEA credit institution holding the opening capital account
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Original bank-stamped letter delivered to the notary; apostille not required for EEA-issued bank references

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Real Decreto Legislativo 1/2010, de 2 de julio (Ley de Sociedades de Capital, 'LSC'), Articles 1-39 (incorporation), 73-92 (SL capital and participaciones), 92-108 (administration), 209-213 (registered office); Regulation of the Commercial Registry, Real Decreto 1784/1996, Articles 125-165.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registro Mercantil Central (name pre-clearance only) and Registro Mercantil Provincial of the province where the registered office is located (deed inscription), under the Dirección General de Seguridad Jurídica y Fe Pública.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Escritura Pública de Constitución (public incorporation deed granted before a Spanish Notary), followed by mandatory inscription (inscripción) in the Mercantile Registry; the company acquires legal personality upon registration (LSC Article 33).
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: SL minimum capital: EUR 3,000 (approx. USD 3,250), fully subscribed and paid up at formation in cash or kind (LSC Articles 4 and 62-72). Cash contributions must be deposited in a Spanish bank account in the company's name and the bank certificate of deposit must be annexed to the deed; no separate public escrow account is required. The share capital must be divided into indivisible participaciones, and capital below EUR 3,000 is prohibited; for the optical lens manufacturing scope no elevated regulatory capital applies.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLUTION No. 1/2025 OF THE FOUNDING GENERAL MEETING OF [COMPANY NAME] S.L. The sole founding member, having executed the deed of incorporation, resolves: (1) to ratify the subscription and payment of the entire share capital of EUR 3,000, divided into 3,000 participaciones of EUR 1.00 each, fully subscribed and paid up; (2) to adopt as the registered office the premises at Calle [●], Madrid, 28001, Spain; (3) to appoint [Name Surname] as sole administrator (Administrador Único) for an indefinite term of office; (4) to authorise the administrator to obtain the provisional NIF, register the company with Social Security, and file the deed in the Mercantile Registry; (5) to defer any other business. Unanimously approved and signed.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Company name pre-clearance (certificación negativa de denominación social)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Mercantil Central, Madrid (online submission via the Registradores de España portal, www.rmc.es).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit an electronic application requesting a negative name certificate, offering up to three optional company names in order of preference. The registry verifies that no identical or confusingly similar name exists on the national index. The certificate is valid for six months after issuance and must be stated in the deed of incorporation.
required_dossiers: Completed solicitud de certificación form
NIF/NIE or passport copies of all founding members
List of proposed company names in preference order
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the certificate is denied because the name is registered or too similar, submit a new application with alternative denominations; a reasoned administrative appeal (recurso de alzada) may be lodged with the Dirección General de Seguridad Jurídica y Fe Pública within one month.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Opening of corporate bank account and share capital deposit
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Any Spanish credit institution supervised by the Banco de España (e.g., Santander, BBVA, CaixaBank, Sabadell).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a 'cuenta de constitución' in the provisional name of the S.L. Each founding member transfers or deposits their subscribed contributions; the aggregate deposit must reach EUR 3,000. The bank issues a 'certificado de depósito' (deposit certificate) naming the subscribers and amounts, which the notary must incorporate into the deed. In-kind contributions require a valuation expert report (informe de experto independiente) except in cases exempt under LSC Article 73.
required_dossiers: Negative name certificate
Certified passports/DNI/NIE of all promoters
Draft statutos (articles of association)
Source of funds declaration under AML rules
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank refuses account opening due to enhanced AML due diligence, provide documented source of funds (bank statements, sale deeds) or apply at another entity; if the bank delays the certificate, request a written refusal and escalate to the Banco de España customer conduct channel as a last resort.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution of the public deed of incorporation before a notary
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Spanish Notary (Notaría) located in the judicial district of the proposed registered office.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Engage a notary and present the preparatory documents. The notary reviews legal capacity of the founders, the legality of the statutos, and the capital deposit; the founders personally attend (or via lawful proxy) and sign the escritura de constitución. The notary then issues the primera copia (official first copy) needed for the Mercantile Registry and a second fiscal copy for AEAT.
required_dossiers: Certificado de denominación social (name certificate)
Bank certificate of capital deposit
Draft statutos signed by the founders
DNI/NIE/passports of all founders
Proof of NIE assigned to foreign founders
Consent of the landlord to use the premises as corporate seat if applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary raises objections (e.g., irregularities in statutos or capital), amend the draft statutos, correct the bank deposit, or adjust the deed text and re-sign; if the notary refuses authorisation, request a written note of refusal and engage a second notary or seek judicial approval under LSC Article 20.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Payment of stamp duty on capital operations (ITP-AJD modalidad operaciones societarias)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Oficina Liquidadora / Agencia Tributaria of the Autonomous Community where the registered office is located.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The notary normally files the tax return (modelo 600) within five business days of the deed; alternatively, the administrator files within 30 calendar days. The applicable AJD rate is set by the regional parliaments (currently 0.75%–1% of nominal capital). Settlement is paid electronically and the receipt is required for registry inscription.
required_dossiers: First copy (or certified copy) of the deed
Modelo 600 self-assessment
Provisional NIF of the company
Negative name certificate and bank deposit certificate copies
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Late filing incurs surcharges (recargo) and interest; submit a supplementary declaración within the voluntary period to minimise penalties; if the regional tax office applies an incorrect rate, lodge a rectification request or administrative appeal (recurso de reposición) within one month.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Mercantil Provincial with territorial jurisdiction over the registered office province.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit to the registrar the first copy of the deed, the receipted modelo 600, the provisional NIF, and the completed registration application (solicitud de inscripción). Filing must occur within two months of the deed date (LSC Article 33). The registrar (registrador) performs legal-calification review of the articles and capital rules; once approved, the inscription is entered and the company acquires legal personality. Obtain a 'certificación de inscripción' as evidence of legal existence.
required_dossiers: Primera copia of the escritura de constitución
Modelo 600 receipt (AJD payment)
Application form solicitud de inscripción signed by the administrator
Evidence of provisional NIF
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registrar issues a negative qualification (calificación), the defects stated in the 'nota de calificación' must be cured within two months by supplementary deed or document; the administrator may file a recurso de alzada to the Dirección General de Seguridad Jurídica y Fe Pública within one month, or institute a judicial appeal before the Juzgado de lo Mercantil.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Definitive NIF (CIF) and employer Social Security registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria (AEAT - State Tax Agency) and Tesorería General de la Seguridad Social (TGSS).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Within one month of registry inscription, file modelo 036 with the local AEAT to convert the provisional NIF into the definitive NIF (CIF), supplying the certificate of registration. Simultaneously, register the company as an employer (inscripción de empresa) with the TGSS at the provincial directorate to obtain an employer account code (código de cuenta de cotización) and open the workplace establishment code (CCC), which is a prerequisite for hiring staff.
required_dossiers: Modelo 036 (census declaration)
Certificate of registration from the Mercantile Registry
Copy of the deed of incorporation and NIF provisional
DNI/NIE of the legal representative
Commercial lease of the registered office / title
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If modelo 036 is rejected due to data mismatches, correct and resubmit electronically via the Cl@ve system; if TGSS refuses employer registration for missing documentation, supply the outstanding form (e.g., TA.6/TA.7, industrial accident coverage agreement) and reapply; internal appeal available within one month of any adverse resolution.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Municipal classified activity license and operational commencement
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Ayuntamiento (City Council) of the municipality where the manufacturing workshop is located, typically through the Concejalía de Urbanismo y Actividades Económicas.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File a 'declaración responsable' or, where the municipal ordinance so requires, an application for 'licencia de actividad clasificada y apertura', accompanied by a technical project prepared by a colegiado architect/engineer covering the activity description, building compliance, fire safety, waste management, and acoustic insulation. The municipal services inspect the premises and, if compliant, issue the operating authorization; commencement of operations without such license is an administrative infraction.
required_dossiers: Declaración responsable / licencia de apertura application
Technical project (memoria técnica) signed by a qualified professional
Fire safety compliance certificate (CTE DB-SI)
Environmental qualification (calificación ambiental) resolution from the regional environmental body
Title or lease contract for the premises
Municipal waste management agreement for industrial scraps and slurries
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the municipality issues a 'requerimiento de subsanación' or a refusal due to technical objections, remedy the stated defects within 10 business days and resubmit; if the activity exceeds the municipal level (e.g., chemical polishing or solvent consumption over thresholds), procure a consolidated environmental permit from the regional Consejería de Medio Ambiente; final remedy is an administrative appeal (recurso de alzada/reposición) or contentious-administrative action before the superior court in Madrid.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Servicio de Actividades Económicas of the competent Ayuntamiento (municipal council) in coordination with the Consejería de Transición Ecológica / Medio Ambiente of the corresponding Autonomous Community; no state-level sector-specific core license is required for precision optical glass lens and camera module manufacturing (per the challenge metadata 'requires_statutory_license: false'), but municipal activity licensing and environmental qualification remain mandatory.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Licencia Municipal de Actividad Clasificada y Apertura (also known as licencia de apertura or declaración responsable, depending on municipal ordinance); governed by Ley 6/2014, de 25 de julio, de Prevención, Calidad y Control Ambiental de Actividades (Comunidad de Madrid) and equivalent regional legislation, together with the municipal economic activities ordinances.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministerio para la Transición Ecológica y el Reto Demográfico (MITERD) and the Consejería de Medio Ambiente of the regional autonomous community, with municipal Calificación Ambiental as the operative instrument for typical SME facilities.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category B/C - Calificación Ambiental Municipal (simplified integrated environmental assessment). A full EIA report is required only above Annex I/II thresholds of the state environmental assessment law (e.g., glass surface grinding of more than 10,000 t/yr input, or processes consuming more than 5 t/yr of hazardous solvents or 25 t/yr of total solvents); the target precision optical lens and surveillance camera module facility using wet grinding of glass/polymer blanks, closed-loop coolant systems, and solvent-free or low-VOC cleaning is below these thresholds and therefore subject only to municipal environmental qualification and registration.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater (municipal sewer discharge): pH 5.5-9.5; total suspended solids ≤ 500 mg/L; COD ≤ 750 mg/L; BOD5 ≤ 300 mg/L; free fats and oils ≤ 40 mg/L; aluminium ≤ 10 mg/L; copper ≤ 1 mg/L; no free chlorine. Air emissions: VOC consumption from cleaning agents below 5 t/yr (EU Industrial Emissions Directive 2010/75/EU Chapter V exemption for surface-cleaning installations); where glass polishing is dry-process, PM10 filter bag efficiency ≥ 95%; noise compliance with municipal acoustic ordinance, typically ≤ 70 dB(A) day / ≤ 60 dB(A) night at the property boundary. Waste: polishing sludge and grinding slurry (EER codes 10 11 10, 12 01 15) shall be segregated, containerised, and handed to an authorised waste manager under Ley 7/2022; packaging waste must be recycled; spent coolant is hazardous waste (EER 12 01 09*) requiring formal hazardous waste documentation.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety: compliance with Código Técnico de la Edificación DB-SI; fire extinguishers, pressurised exits, fire doors, and annual maintenance certification signed by a competent technician; mandatory 'Certificado de Protección Contra Incendios' for the activity. Structural inspection: 'Informe de Evaluación del Edificio' where the building predates 1980, plus a load-bearing calculation for heavy grinding/cooling equipment installations. Occupational clearance: 'Evaluación de Riesgos Laborales' and 'Plan de Prevención de Riesgos Laborales' under Ley 31/1995 de Prevención de Riesgos Laborales, covering exposure to airborne glass dust, noise, vibration, manual handling, and chemical agents; initial medical surveillance of employees exposed to noise ≥ 80 dB(A) and respirable silica/glass dust, and registration of the workplace with the regional occupational safety authority; Plan de Autoprotección (self-protection plan) required where occupancy or risk profile so dictates.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria (AEAT), accessible via the electronic portal at sede.agenciatributaria.gob.es; local tax offices administer the Census of Entrepreneurs, Professionals and Withholders.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: For a Spanish Sociedad de Responsabilidad Limitada (SL), the company must request a provisional NIF (Número de Identificación Fiscal) from AEAT before notarial incorporation using Form 036/036 pre-registration; after inscription in the Commercial Registry, the definitive NIF is issued. Foreign non-resident entities without a permanent establishment must appoint a Spanish tax representative and apply through Form 036 for a non-resident NIF (prefixed with the letter N) for income and VAT purposes, or register through the EU OSS/IOSS schemes where applicable. The NIF is also the VAT identification number for Spanish taxable persons (ES + NIF in EU transactions).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Spain does not operate a check-the-box regime. Statutory elections available include voluntary application of the Spanish tax consolidation regime for groups under Articles 100-112 of the Corporate Income Tax Law (LIS), the special ETVE (holding company) regime for eligible parent companies, the patent box regime for qualifying intangible income, and the SOCIMI (REIT) election. These elections require formal communication to AEAT and compliance with substance and policy conditions. Hybrid mismatch rules under ATAD are mandatory and do not provide elective treatment.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT (IVA - Impuesto sobre el Valor Añadido)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: 0 EUR (no de minimis threshold; any taxable person carrying out taxable supplies of goods or services in Spain must register with AEAT before commencing activity, and non-established operators must register from their first taxable transaction, subject to OSS/IOSS procedures)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Large businesses (turnover above EUR 6,000,000) and VAT groups must participate in the SII (Suministro Inmediato de Información), submitting invoice records to AEAT electronically within four days of issue/receipt. The Crea y Crece framework (Royal Decree 1007/2023) mandates structured electronic invoicing between business operators, and Verifactu requires certified invoicing software that may transmit records to AEAT on request. There is no universal real-time fiscal clearance or mandatory digital stamping for all taxpayers, but AEAT maintains real-time taxpayer information through SII and e-invoicing requirements.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of goods dispatched or transported by the seller or on behalf of the seller outside the European Union qualify as exempt from VAT with credit (0% effective rating) under Article 21 of the Spanish VAT Law, provided the export is evidenced by the Single Administrative Document and customs release, and transport is completed within the statutory period. Certain services directly related to exported goods, such as transportation, loading, handling and ancillary services, may also qualify; the recipient must be a taxable person established outside Spain where required for B2B service export treatment.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (SAD / ECS supporting certificate, DUA in Spain)
Bill of Lading, Air Waybill, CMR or other valid transport document showing dispatch to a non-EU destination
Commercial invoice evidencing the export transaction and parties
Inward Remittance Certificate / proof of payment from the overseas buyer (where available, supporting the export and foreign-currency conversion)
Intrastat declaration or destination-specific documentation if applicable
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: AEAT may disallow the zero-rating and reclaim output VAT if the taxpayer fails to produce complete and coherent export proof or the goods are subsequently found to have remained in or returned to the EU. Under the Spanish General Tax Law (LGT), this results in tax assessment, late-payment interest, and penalties ranging from 15% to 50% of the tax amount for non-concealment or from 50% to 150% for concealment. Fraudulent export invoicing or documentation knowingly used to obtain undue VAT refunds exposes the company and directors to criminal tax liability, including imprisonment and fines, where defrauded revenue exceeds EUR 120,000 per tax period.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Spain adheres to the Eurozone monetary framework granting full capital account convertibility and current account convertibility. Profit remittances to non-resident shareholders face no regulatory restrictions beyond standard beneficial ownership verification, tax reporting to the AEAT, and anti-money laundering compliance.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Export proceeds must be declared and converted to EUR within ten business days for statistical reporting under the Foreign Trade Statistics Regulation. No mandatory surrender ratio or central bank conversion obligation applies; companies may retain proceeds offshore provided they maintain proper documentation, file export declarations, and comply with transfer pricing and tax authority notifications.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: High feasibility rating for regulated electronic money institutions such as Revolut Business or N26 Corporate, subject to Spanish licensing under MiCA and Banco de España oversight. Legal constraints include mandatory Spanish tax residency compliance, enhanced AML screening for cross-border transfers, and prohibition on unlicensed crypto-asset custody.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Remote KYC and digital onboarding is permitted for Spanish SL entities via certified digital signatures (e.g., Cl@ve or FNMT) and video verification; physical presence is required only for initial company incorporation or transactions exceeding established thresholds.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarized ownership structure chart, Registro Mercantil extract, and proof of ultimate beneficial owners via passport or national ID
Bank statements, export invoices, tax returns, and third-party verification letters from counterparties
Sanctions list screening report and adverse media search

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant inbound capital injections via SWIFT MT103 or MT202 with purpose code 'Capital Contribution' or 'Equity Injection'. IBAN verification required; documentation must include board resolution and shareholder agreement. Verification through KYC/AML protocols and tax authority notifications.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Clearing rails primarily via SWIFT MT103 for trade settlements. Commercial Letters of Credit (LC) under UCP 600 for larger transactions. All payments must reference export invoice numbers and comply with transfer pricing documentation if applicable.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Forward contracts for EUR/USD or other pairs
Currency swaps for multi-currency exposure management

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Filing of Annual Accounts with Registro Mercantil
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 1 month after approval by the General Shareholders' Meeting
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fines of 300-3,000 EUR; non-compliance may result in administrative strike-off
Penalties of 5% per month of tax due plus interest; possible criminal liability for grave negligence

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory independent audit if exceeding two of: net turnover exceeding 2,000,000 EUR, total assets exceeding 1,000,000 EUR, or average number of employees exceeding 50
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Spanish General Accounting Plan (PGC) or IFRS as required

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Annual accounts filing discloses current shareholding; no separate annual UBO confirmation required
